event: Jamestown, first permanent English colony, is founded.
The Mayflower lands at Plymouth.
The French and Indian War begins.
The Boston Tea Party takes place.
The Battles of Lexington and Concord begin the Revolutionary War.
The Declaration of Independence is adopted.
The British surrender at Yorktown.
The U.S. Constitution is signed in Philadelphia.
George Washington is inaugurated as the first President.
The Louisiana Purchase doubles the size of the United States.
The Civil War begins.
The Emancipation Proclamation takes effect.
The Civil War ends and the 13th Amendment abolishes slavery.
The 19th Amendment grants women the right to vote.
The United States enters World War II after Pearl Harbor.
Martin Luther King Jr. delivers the 'I Have a Dream' speech.
Apollo 11 lands the first astronauts on the Moon.
The United States celebrates its Bicentennial.
Terrorist attacks strike the United States on September 11.
The United States celebrates its Semiquincentennial (250th).
